xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4456: Overdeck Anywhere docs are stale: pricing page says nothing has shipped, CLI references and changelog entries missing

plan.title: Overdeck Anywhere docs are stale: pricing page says nothing has shipped, CLI references and changelog entries missing
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: 13 files, all documentation, one subsystem (user docs); items are per-page and mostly parallel.

narratives.Problem: The Overdeck Anywhere user docs contradict main: anywhere.mdx says nothing has shipped and promises a non-existent pan vault migrate; remote-access.mdx describes a dashboard vault unlock that does not exist (PAN-4446 is open); changelog.mdx's v0.65.0 block misses six merged Anywhere PRs; CHANGELOG.md has no Anywhere coverage; there are no CLI pages for pan vault, pan pair, pan devices or pan token; conversations.mdx omits browse rows and Continue here; the docs.json Anywhere group holds only the pricing page; the pan-vault skill omits the dashboard flows.
narratives.Proposal: Per-page documentation edits lowered from .pan/drafts/pan-4456.md: rewrite the anywhere.mdx status with version attribution (v0.64.0 vs next release v0.65.0 vs planned), correct remote-access.mdx and session-vault.mdx, add six changelog.mdx entries and an insert-only CHANGELOG.md subsection, create four CLI reference pages from command source, link them from cli/overview.mdx, regroup docs.json, document browse rows and Continue here, and extend the pan-vault skill. Every statement is verified against the source files named in the PRD.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to any file under src/, including stale strings in src/lib/remote-access/anywhere-status.ts and src/cli/commands/pair.ts
- No dashboard vault set-up, join or unlock (PAN-4446)
- No edit to the released v0.64.0 changelog block or to existing CHANGELOG.md content
- No rewrite of the anywhere.mdx pricing analysis beyond the lines named in WI-1
- No removal of pre-existing em dashes outside text this issue writes
- No new test files and no Mintlify dependency
- No change to docs/SESSION-VAULT.md, docs/DASHBOARD-AUTH.md or .overdeck/context/codebase/*
- No changelog entries for non-Anywhere PRs
- No claim that /ws/terminal heartbeats exist (PAN-4434 is open)

autoDecisions.summary: Attribute every shipped claim to v0.64.0 or 'next release (v0.65.0)'
autoDecisions.rationale: Six of the features are merged to main but unreleased; the docs site deploys from main, so an unqualified 'shipped' is false for npm 0.64.0 users.

autoDecisions.summary: Move session-vault and remote-access from the Configuration group into the Overdeck Anywhere group instead of listing them twice; list the four CLI pages only in the Anywhere group and link them from cli/overview.mdx
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for these pages in the Anywhere group; a page listed in two Mintlify groups gives ambiguous navigation. URLs do not change, so the DOCS_PAGE strings in pair.ts and token.ts stay correct.

autoDecisions.summary: CHANGELOG.md gets one insert-only '### Added: Overdeck Anywhere' subsection under Unreleased
autoDecisions.rationale: docs/RELEASING.md line 120 names changelog.mdx as the maintained public changelog; CHANGELOG.md's Unreleased section is stale developer content that this docs issue should not restructure.

autoDecisions.summary: Em dash rule: zero in the pages this issue owns; unchanged counts in features/conversations.mdx (39) and cli/overview.mdx (1)
autoDecisions.rationale: Surgical-change rule: rewriting unrelated existing prose is out of scope, while all new text obeys the no-em-dash acceptance.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep pan vault migrate in anywhere.mdx only as a planned hosted-vault exit promise; remove 'moving your vault to another backend' from the free Phase A list
autoDecisions.rationale: The command does not exist (src/cli/commands/vault/index.ts); the exit promise is pricing policy tied to PAN-4297, so it stays, phrased as future.

autoDecisions.summary: Four separate CLI pages (vault, pair, devices, token)
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names four commands; one page each matches cli/hygiene.mdx and keeps items parallel.

autoDecisions.summary: No source changes, including stale code strings in anywhere-status.ts and pair.ts
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue is documentation only; the vault-locked message belongs to PAN-4446.

autoDecisions.summary: Nav check via a node one-liner, with `npx mint broken-links` as an implementation checkpoint; no new test file
autoDecisions.rationale: No Mintlify CLI or docs CI exists in the repo; adding a dependency or test file is beyond the issue's scope.
